extensionName.message: Better Gesture — trackpad swipe to browse tab history

extensionDescription.message: Pull two fingers on the trackpad to open this tab's history list, or close a link-opened tab and return to the page it came from.

menuTitleBack.description: History menu heading when going back.

menuTitleForward.description: History menu heading when going forward.

menuClose.description: Label for the history menu close button.

menuLoading.description: Shown while the service worker reads the session history.

menuGestureHelp.message: Keep pulling, move up or down, then let go
menuGestureHelp.description: Footer hint inside the history menu.

menuEmptyBack.message: This tab has no previous page to go back to.
menuEmptyBack.description: Empty state for the back menu.

menuEmptyForward.message: This tab has no page to go forward to.
menuEmptyForward.description: Empty state for the forward menu.

menuStepPrevious.description: Distance label for the entry one step back.

menuStepsBack.description: Distance label for an entry more than one step back.

menuStepNext.description: Distance label for the entry one step forward.

menuStepsForward.description: Distance label for an entry more than one step forward.

menuOpenerRow.description: Distance label on the row that returns to the opening tab.

untitledPage.description: Fallback title for a history entry with no title.

openerPageTitle.message: The page that opened this tab
openerPageTitle.description: Fallback title for the opening tab when its own title is unavailable.

errorGeneric.message: History is unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
errorGeneric.description: Shown instead of an unrecognized internal error.

errorInvalidEntry.message: That history entry is not valid.
errorInvalidEntry.description: The content script asked for an entry id that is not an integer.

errorHistoryRead.message: Could not read this tab's history.

errorOpenerGone.message: Could not return to the page that opened this tab. It may have been closed.
errorOpenerGone.description: The opening tab disappeared between opening the menu and choosing the row.

errorHistoryChanged.message: This page's history changed. Please open the menu again.
errorHistoryChanged.description: The chosen entry is no longer in the expected direction.

errorDebuggerDetached.message: The debugger was detached, so the history could not be read.
errorDebuggerDetached.description: The user cancelled the debugger banner or DevTools took over.

errorDebuggerBusy.message: DevTools or another debugger is attached to this tab. Close it and try again.
errorDebuggerBusy.description: chrome.debugger.attach failed because something else is attached.

errorProtectedPage.message: History cannot be opened on pages Chrome protects.
errorProtectedPage.description: The tab is a privileged page.

errorTabGone.message: The tab was closed or is no longer available.

errorContextInvalidated.message: The extension was updated. Please reload this page.
errorContextInvalidated.description: The old content script can no longer reach the service worker.

errorHistoryLoad.message: Could not load this tab's history.
errorHistoryLoad.description: Fallback when the worker reports a failure with no message.

errorNavigate.message: Could not go to that page.
errorNavigate.description: Fallback when navigation fails with no message.

thresholdShort.description: Shortest of the three hold-still durations.

thresholdLong.description: Longest of the three hold-still durations.

popupSite.description: Per-site on/off for the page in the active tab.

popupSiteUnavailable.description: Shown instead of a hostname when the active tab is a page the extension cannot run on.

popupDirection.description: Which swipe direction means going back.

popupThreshold.description: Label for the hold-still duration picker.

popupNotice.message: Reload any tab that was open before you installed this. It does not work on Chrome settings, the new tab page, or the Web Store.
popupNotice.description: First-run note at the bottom of the popup.

statusSaved.description: Shown after a setting is stored.

popupLanguage.description: Label for the language picker in the popup.

languageAuto.description: Language picker option that follows the Chrome UI language.

languageTag.description: BCP 47 tag for this locale, used for the document lang attribute.

thresholdSeconds.description: Hold-still duration in seconds, shown under each option name.
